purpose: Test whether the Cognitive Kernel measurably displaces human attention or downstream rework without degrading verified completion or authority boundaries.
claim_scope: measurement-feasibility and descriptive pilot only; no general efficacy claim

design.pairing_rule: same task family, model family/version, tools, permissions, stopping rule, verification procedure, and pinned base state; control and kernel execute in independent fresh contexts
design.order_rule: randomize condition assignment to isolated task instances; do not rely on sequential crossover or washout
design.rationale: historical work was not assigned under the same prospective protocol and must not be treated as a clean control

pilot_targets.note: Targets are for pilot coverage and variance/measurement estimation, not statistical power.

outcomes.human_minutes_definition: active human attention only; do not substitute elapsed wall-clock time
outcomes.verified_completion_definition: task-appropriate external or deterministic check fixed before outcome inspection

analysis_plan.promotion_rule: pilot may justify a confirmatory study only if measurement is reliable, at least one claimed scarcity shows practically meaningful improvement, and no hard-boundary regression appears

stop_conditions: task pairing cannot be made materially comparable
human attention cannot be measured without retrospective guessing
condition leakage contaminates the intended control
boundary violations increase in a way that makes continued exposure unjustified
control and kernel conditions are not demonstrably isolated from one another
provenance_policy: retain raw JSONL records and evidence references; summaries are derived and regenerable Record assignment_id, independence_level, and pinned base_state for every condition.
amendment_policy: changes after outcome inspection must be versioned and marked exploratory
amendment_reason: No outcomes collected. Sequential crossover is inappropriate where a cognitive intervention may persist through context, learning, strategy transfer, or mutable state.
